description: Read-only contract call (eth_call): decodes the return value of a function you name, e.g. balanceOf(address) returns (uint256). Nothing is signed or sent. A function whose name reads like a write (transfer, approve, mint, set...) is refused unless it is declared view or pure. Related tools on this server, for a different need: evm_balance when you need ERC-20 balance of an address for one token contract; evm_contract when you need to check whether an EVM contract is verified and its ABI. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

name: evm_call
title: Read the result of a read-only EVM contract function
